card.title: Who’s Cleaning This Up?
card.instruction: Treat every idea according to the work, cost, cleanup, and follow-through it will create.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You want three extra tables at the party. Who carries them home?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I will. Can we put the deposit on your card?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I need the return time. Those tables are staying on my bill until the van gets home.
